text: Argel Tal serves the Word Bearers during the destruction of Monarchia and the crisis that follows. His loyalty to Lorgar draws him into the Legion’s search for beings that will accept its worship.

He leads warriors into the Eye of Terror under Ingethel’s guidance. They return as the Gal Vorbak, sharing their bodies with daemonic presences; Argel Tal’s is named Raum. His relationship with Cyrene Valantion preserves a human connection amid that transformation.
He participates in the betrayal at Isstvan V. His path joins the Legion’s spiritual change to the deliberate destruction of its former allies.
